lines: Rajesh Kesavan Nambisan, role unknown, is due offer-for-sale proceeds after selling 2,136,000 shares in the offer.
Proceeds of ₹70.49 crore are scheduled for On or about Tuesday, November 3, 2026 per the offer document, not yet confirmed by a listing notice.
Retained shares are estimated at ₹81.07 crore at offer price, so more value may follow later for them.
Average cost of acquisition is not confirmed from the documents, so the gain is unknown.
